column1: # Common-core mapping from ligand A to ligand B, one atom-name pair per row.
# Mapped atoms are linearly mixed; unmapped atoms of each ligand become soft-core.
# Rows must follow ligand A atom order, and the mapped ligand B atoms must appear
# in the same order (pmemd pairs common atoms by order). Mapped atoms must overlay
# within 0.1 A in the two MOL2 files.
# Example: benzene -> toluene with antechamber names from the RCSB BNZ/MBN ideal SDF.
